instruction.text: Modern supermarkets have an even wider range of products than they did in the past. What three things might you find in a modern supermarket?

feedback.end: That’s right! In some supermarkets, you can even buy mobile phones!

instruction.text: After the invention of supermarkets, shopping centres were also created. Find the stairs to learn more.

feedback.end: A shopping centre is a place with lots of different shops in one big building, often with multiple floors. They usually have shops, restaurants and maybe even a cinema!

atoms.b: Many people also enjoy ((++shopping sleeping)) on the internet. You can shop for things such as ((friends ++clothes)), groceries and much more!

instruction.text: You are speaking to Mark, who likes online shopping. Fill in the gaps.

atoms.b: Why do you like doing your ((dancing ++shopping)) online, Mark?
atoms.sound: Why do you like doing your shopping online Mark?

atoms.b: I prefer shopping online because it’s much ((slower ++quicker)) than in person, and I can do it from home.
Can you do your food ((++shopping cooking)) online as well?
Of course! I like to order my food shopping from ((++the_supermarket the_park)) online. When it’s ready, they deliver it right to my front door!
What about if you’re shopping for ((tigers ++clothes))?
When I’m shopping for clothes online, I can see exactly what they have in stock, as well as the different ((++colours stains)). I can even look at the reviews if I like!
